title: FlapLab Daily — Into The Eye.exe
story: You are NOAA hurricane hunter 'Miss Piggy'. Hold to thrust and punch through the eyewall while the palm trees bend sideways.
inspiration: Hurricane Isaias made Florida landfall Oct 10 2026 and Hurricane Simon hit Cat 4 off Mexico (the noise / NPR, Oct 10 2026). Fly-mode physics = hurricane hunter flight. NOAA WP-3D N42RF, ISS eye photo (Milton 2024), Key West palms — all Wikimedia, rembg.
